summary: The board contains at most 25 cells, so the complete legal workload is too tightly bounded for an honest asymptotic scaling verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: Both board dimensions are at most 5, and only dimension/start tuples admitting a complete tour are generated.

replacement_checks.evidence: Backtracking has depth at most 25, considers no more than eight knight moves per state, and stores one 25-cell board plus the recursion path.
Regression validates the visit permutation, requested start, board bounds, and every consecutive knight move for all 46 legal dimension/start tuples within the 5 by 5 source domain.
The independent regression reconstructs coordinates by visit number and verifies each transition has absolute coordinate differences one and two.
